actions.action: Bind approvals to exact paragraph revisions
actions.mechanism: An approval covers one source paragraph revision and one translation revision, never just their stable IDs.
actions.implementation: Store immutable revisions and approval tuples containing language, both paragraph IDs, both revision IDs, and reviewer. Content edits create revisions; moves change placement only.
actions.check: Edit approved source text: publication must block. Leave another paragraph unchanged: its approval must remain valid.
actions.risk: Reusing revision IDs would silently defeat this protection.

actions.action: Track context dependencies separately from paragraph text
actions.mechanism: A moved paragraph can retain its wording while losing the context that made its translation accurate.
actions.implementation: Record dependencies on headings, neighboring references, and defined terms. Placement or dependency changes trigger contextual review without modifying unrelated approvals.
actions.check: Move a paragraph beneath a different heading: flag its context for review while preserving an unrelated unchanged paragraph’s approval.
actions.risk: Missing dependencies can conceal context-sensitive translation errors.

actions.mechanism: Paragraph-level diffs concentrate human accuracy checks on affected content rather than restarting each language.
actions.implementation: For each language, queue stale or context-flagged paragraphs with old/new source, translation, and surrounding text. Split ownership between its two volunteers; route uncertainty to the other.
actions.check: Introduce one substantive edit: all six languages receive its packet, and approval requires a human decision against the new revision.
actions.risk: Overly narrow excerpts can hide meaning-changing context.

actions.action: Publish from a validated immutable snapshot
actions.mechanism: A release snapshot prevents source edits arriving during publication from bypassing approval checks.
actions.implementation: Freeze source revisions, translations, ordering, and context-review status in a release manifest. Validate every approval against it; generate all six language editions exclusively from that manifest.
actions.check: Change source after validation begins: the build must use the frozen approved revision or fail, never include unapproved updated text.
actions.risk: A valid frozen release may omit newer changes; label its revision.
